verdict.rationale: Okta's event hooks provide outbound, event-triggered automation running in the background (okta-docs-4), and the Okta MCP server lets an AI agent issue commands against Okta's admin APIs (okta-docs-9, okta-gh-1/2/3), but none of the evidence shows a mechanism for scheduling or continuously running autonomous agentic workflows without a triggering event or explicit invocation. Missing for 10: documentation of scheduled/persistent background agent execution, evidence of autonomous multi-step workflows (e.g., Okta Workflows) tied to AI agents, and independent confirmation of such automations running unattended.
